topic: Data API and reporting issues resolution
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on debugging and improving the data API, particularly concerning traffic reporting. Issues were noted regarding discrepancies between data provided by the API and data shown on internal dashboards (specifically related to Singapore data). A significant point of concern was the need for a refactoring effort to ensure consistent queries across both the API and other systems. The team reviewed the API endpoint for unique traffic reports, noting that it requires network parameters and proper granularity settings. Finally, an issue found in the staging environment was fixed by reverting two commits.
decisions: The data-api changes were approved for deployment to production after testing on staging.
A refactoring task needs to be scheduled to standardize queries between the API and dashboards.
action_items: Set a due date in ClickUp for the API refactoring ticket.
Review and fix network parameter handling for the unique traffic report endpoint.
